rules.name: NVIDIA shader caches
rules.why: NVIDIA's compiled shader and compute caches. The driver rebuilds them automatically; the first launch of a game afterwards may be slightly slower.
sources: NVIDIA stores DX/GL/compute shader caches under %LOCALAPPDATA%\NVIDIA and NV_Cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\NVIDIA Corporation; both are regenerated by the driver.

rules.name: AMD shader caches
rules.why: AMD's DirectX/Vulkan/OpenGL shader caches. The driver rebuilds them automatically.
sources: AMD stores Dx/Dxc/GL/Vk shader caches under %LOCALAPPDATA%\AMD; they are regenerated by the driver.

rules.name: Intel shader cache
rules.why: Intel graphics driver shader cache. Rebuilt automatically by the driver.
sources: Intel graphics stores its shader cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Intel\ShaderCache; it is regenerated by the driver.
